description: Open-source Chatterbox family for expressive TTS and voice conversion, with emotion exaggeration control, fast generation, zero-shot voice cloning, and an integrated multilingual TTS path.

request.name: exaggeration
request.description: Emotion exaggeration. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: T3 classifier-free guidance scale. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: temperature
request.description: T3 sampling temperature. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: T3 repetition penalty. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: min_p
request.description: Minimum sampling probability. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus sampling probability. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: flow_guidance_scale
request.description: S3Gen flow guidance scale. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated speech tokens. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Enable sampling. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: stop_on_eos
request.description: Stop token generation on EOS. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Voice conversion flow steps; max_steps is also accepted.

request.name: seed
request.description: Sampling seed; omitted chooses a random seed. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.

request.name: source_audio
request.description: Voice conversion source WAV path; overrides audio_input.

request.name: target_voice
request.description: Voice conversion target WAV path; overrides the speaker reference.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Weight storage type; defaults to native.

session.name: conditionals_cache_slots
session.description: Cached speaker conditionals; zero disables reuse.

session.name: encoder_condition_samples
session.description: Maximum reference samples for the T3 tokenizer; the voice encoder still consumes the full 16 kHz reference.

session.name: decoder_condition_samples
session.description: S3Gen reference sample limit at 24 kHz.

session.name: t3_speech_cond_prompt_len
session.description: T3 reference speech prompt token limit.
